messages:
cheng (eng-arch): Quick follow-up from the kernel-selection RFC: we've seen a few surprising perf regressions when L4 uses the 'fast-attn' path under certain seq-len distributions. Need to align on a gating contract.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Seen that too. Pattern is: short prefix + long decode -> L4 picks fast-attn but ends up thrashing L2 and kernel stalls.

maya (eng-ml): Can you paste the perf trace? IIRC fast-attn assumes contiguous KV in L2 which L4 doesn't guarantee for large KV sharding.

build-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-19T14:10:02 completed to probe-asia-l4-pool (canary-id: cny-302).

cheng (eng-arch): Attaching simplified trace snippet:
```
KS: select_kernel(attn_meta){
  if (sm_has_fast_dotp && seq_len <= 512 && kv_locality >= 0.8) return fast-attn;
  if (quantized && sm_has_int8_conv) return int8-attn;
  return generic-attn;
}
```

tanya (eng-sre): One operational note: L4 GPU topology reports a slightly different SM count under driver v525, we had a stale capability bit flip in prod-mex. Might explain mis-detection.

maya (eng-ml): So two orthogonal problems: capability detection (driver/SM meta) and the heuristic using only seq_len + kv_locality. We should add an explicit memory-bandwidth-saturation probe.

cheng (eng-arch): Proposal: tighten gating contract to require three signals: sm_fast_dotp True, kv_locality > 0.85, and mem_saturation_estimate < 0.6. If any missing -> fallback to generic-attn. Also add health-probe that runs micro-benchmarks on new driver versions.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Agreed. Implementation notes: health-probe runs on node init and periodically. It returns capability_flags + micro_latency_samples. We'll store a compact JSON in the node metadata and let router consult it.

maya (eng-ml): Add one more signal: recent-regression-window. If the model's p99 token latency rose > 15% after enabling fast-attn, auto-revert for that model variant and flag for triage.

tanya (eng-sre): We should also include fallback grace windows to avoid flip-flop during autoscaling. E.g., require 10 minutes stable before flipping to fast-attn for a node.

cheng (eng-arch): Action items: 1) sanjay - add mem_saturation probe and node metadata export (PR by Thu). 2) maya - add model-level p99 guard and alert + eval hook (PR by Fri). 3) tanya - create canary plan that exercises short-prefix + long-decode patterns across A100/H100/L4 (run next Tue).

build-bot: Created issue INF-2147: "SM gating: add mem_probe + stable-window + model p99 guard" (link: https://redwood.local/INF-2147).

cheng (eng-arch): One more discussion point: do we allow router-level overrides per-customer? Enterprise tenants may prefer conservative defaults. Thoughts?

maya (eng-ml): Yes — add customer_telemetry_opt_out flag and an explicit override policy that requires explicit consent to use fast-attn on private deployments.

sanjay (eng-runtime): I'll prototype the kernel-selection function with the three-signal contract and a compact telemetry payload for rollout. Will ping for review once tests pass.

cheng (eng-arch): Sounds good. If nobody objects I'll merge the gating RFC follow-up into the main RFC doc and land the probes next week. :thumbsup:

maya (eng-ml): No objections. Also adding unit tests for L4 edgecases (sharded KV layout).

tanya (eng-sre): I'll schedule the canary and add escalation steps to the runbook.

sanjay (eng-runtime): FYI I'll include a small synthetic workload generator to reproduce the short-prefix/long-decode pattern.

cheng (eng-arch): Thanks all — closing thread after PRs are up.
